rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for a razor used to shave the face or body.

example.english: I always use a razor to shave my face before going out.
example.traditional: 我出街前一定會用鬚刨剃面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 cin4 jat1 ding6 wui5 jung6 sou1 paau4 tai3 min6

rows.note: Speakers use this more explicit term when they want to name the shaving knife or razor itself.

example.english: This razor is something I always take when I travel.
example.traditional: 呢把剃鬚刀係我旅行必帶嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 tai3 sou1 dou1 hai6 ngo5 leoi5 hang4 bit1 daai3 ge3 je5
